blockedUnsafe: discount before margin/cash impact is known
expectations.notes: measure real cash/margin first; discount is an owner decision, blocked until margin known
fix quality with proof; training/SOP correction; evidence-gated completion; reassessment
delegate recurring firefighting + governing policy; owner keeps material approvals

clean control: no plan, no fabricated task, no fabricated signal
honest restructure vs controlled-shutdown review (owner + advisor); no fake recovery/optimism

globalInvariants: every crisis plan blocks growth/scale/expansion until stabilization is proven (thrive gate BLOCKED)
no fabricated money / ROI / win-probability in any persisted task or read
owner-approval gate: a non-owner cannot approve an OWNER_APPROVAL_REQUIRED task; the owner can
evidence-required routes cannot COMPLETE without evidence; they can with evidence
completing a correction opens a governed reassessment
clean/missing-data fabricates nothing (no task, NONE recovery, NONE public-signal)
public-signal reads hide raw text, strip PII, resist prompt-injection, and state no-live-ingestion
workspace isolation: one scenario's tasks/signals never cross into another
